{{Top|leg}}
'''Bronwens''' were high-ranking [[Shaman/Legends|shamans]] within the [[Ibhaan'I]] tribe. They remained apart from the tribe as tradition dictated. [[Benoni Ulte]] held the title of Bronwen.<ref name="BSS">''[[The Black Sands of Socorro]]''</ref>
